## What and why
Explain the problem and the focused change.

## Verification
List commands and results, and anything not tested. For phone behavior, distinguish automated checks from on-device testing.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Regression coverage and relevant documentation updated, or not applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private hostnames, chat/state data or unrelated generated output.
- [ ] Third-party attribution preserved where applicable.
- [ ] State compatibility and migration/rollback considered where applicable.
